maria: Hey - running into a weird combo with py-sdk streaming + auth retries.

maria: Repro: start an async generator that yields a "prefix" chunk then longer streams. When the request gets a 401 mid-stream, the client auto-refreshes token and retries — the resumed stream starts by re-emitting the prefix again, so the consumer sees the prefix twice. Also if you annotate the handler as Iterator[str] vs AsyncIterator[...] typing mismatch warnings bubble up. Minimal snippet:
```
async def stream():
    yield "meta: start\n"
    for i in range(3):
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        yield f"chunk:{i}\n"

# client usage
async for part in client.stream_generate(...):
    process(part)
```

maria: After a 401 retry the stream emits "meta: start" twice and then continues. If I cancel the outer task after partial read, socket sometimes stays open.

ken: Thanks — can you share sdk version and auth flow? sounds like retry wraps the generator and replays buffered prefix. Are you using the default prefix caching?

maria: py-sdk 0.12.4, OAuth2 refresh token managed by our app, we use the SDK's auth hook. Not using explicit prefix cache; this looks like the first SSE/frame is buffered in the client's stream state and replayed after reconnect.

sam: I wonder if the client is calling _on_stream_start() then buffering until headers validate, then on retry replays that buffer. Could be a race between token refresh and generator finalizer.

maria: repro attached as gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/abc123 — includes small FastAPI endpoint that simulates a 401 after the prefix then resumes. Also saw typing issue: mypy complains because client.stream_generate() is typed as Iterable[str] but yields async bytes in runtime. Not consistent.

ken: @maria thanks. Can you try patching client to not replay any bytes if status changed? quick hack: drop buffer on 401. But we need a test and fix; this is likely in the SSE parser + reconnect path.

devx-bot: Incoming issue created: DEVEX-1248 "py-sdk: replayed prefix on mid-stream auth retry + typing mismatch for async streams" — assigned to @ken

ken: I'll take a look. Plan: write unit that simulates auth refresh mid-stream, assert no prefix replay and ensure generator cleanup closes socket. Also update typing to return AsyncIterator[str] for streaming endpoints and add runtime checks.

maria: Thanks! For the cancel/cleanup part, reproducer: start stream, read 1 chunk, cancel task. On CPython 3.11 I saw FD linger for ~10s. Happy to help debug.

sam: If it's generator finalizer ordering, weakref.finalize may hide exception. We'll add a test with socketpair to ensure close on task cancel.

maria: Awesome. ping me when there's a patch — I can validate with our sample app.

ken: Will do. TL;DR: reproduce -> add unit -> fix replay buffer + typing -> release patch.
